            content = f.read()

        from dparse.parser import parse, filetypes
        dependency_file = parse(content, path=file_path, file_type=filetypes.requirements_txt, resolve=True)

            if pkg_name in remediations:

                for spec_str, rem_data in remediations[pkg_name].items():

                        # Create SafetyRequirement from the dependency
                        req = SafetyRequirement(f"{pkg_name}{spec_str}")
                        req.remediation = rem_data
                        to_fix_spec.append(req)

        file_fixes = process_fixes_scan(file_to_fix, to_fix_spec, auto_remediation_limit, output, no_output, prompt)
